candidates.cluster: fixed consecutive three-month clusters aligned to declared origin
fixed aligned nonoverlapping blocks of L complete calendar months
candidates.block_origin: first complete entry month of each partition

common_inference.score: cluster sum of observations minus count times null mean
common_inference.family: one-sided Romano-Wolf stepdown over EMA pullback, bull flag, double bottom, common candidate-aligned weights

tie_rule.enumeration: all Rademacher sign vectors, fixed lexicographic order
tie_rule.exceedance: bootstrap statistic >= observed statistic, including equality

eligibility.decision: ineligible if floor cannot reach both nominal gates

paired_audit.candidate_weight_mapping: use the first base-month sign in each aligned candidate cluster under a fixed mapping
paired_audit.mandatory_size_qualification: every mandatory null scenario must pass confidence and family limits
paired_audit.selection: among qualifying candidates, maximize the minimum projected fraction jointly rejecting WCR-S confidence at 2.5% and Romano-Wolf family at 5% at delta_MME across mandatory power scenarios and patterns at one common declared projection sample size; break exact ties by larger nonempty cluster count at that size
paired_audit.after_selection: recompute pattern-specific N_required >= 100 and G_required >= 6 and minimum detectable effect under chosen method; require >=80% prospective power
paired_audit.projection_sample_size_status: UNFROZEN_CONDITIONAL_PROPOSAL: freeze only if complete candidate rankings by minimum projected power are identical at N=200 and N=430 for effects 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, and 0.30; bull-flag feasibility remains separate

mandatory.generator: development/validation calibrated joint pattern block resampling
mandatory.parameters: fixed by predeclared calibration recipe; concrete values unresolved until authorized source is available

mandatory.generator: joint pattern zero-mean heteroskedastic shocks with monthly lognormal volatility; Gaussian log-volatility AR(1) latent phi is log(1 + target_observed_phi * (exp(0.6^2) - 1)) / 0.6^2, approximately 0.4972628264
mandatory.evidence: approved July-2014-corrected market proxy realised-volatility lag-one correlation

mandatory.generator: joint pattern zero-mean AR(1) monthly-average shocks; center iid Gaussian trade residuals within each month, scale by sqrt(n/(n-1)) for n > 1 to retain unit residual variance, and add 0.35 times the common AR(1) state; generate the exact month-specific trade count before centering
mandatory.note: 0.25 is an explicit mandatory stress beyond observed monthly-return persistence
0 denotes true null and d denotes the declared positive delta_MME alternative; complete and all one- and two-null partial configurations

sensitivity.note: previous generic Gaussian pilot cells are disclosed sensitivity after the dependence-model amendment

scenario_matrix.size_recentring: entire mixture recentered to true mean zero

seeds.power_projection_derivation: SHA-256 of base seed, ordered scenario id and replicate index; use first 64 bits as unsigned PCG64 seed for that replicate's outer draw or inner sign matrix
